title: Event homelabnext.agent.job.finished
description: The usage record of one agent job (one run in the orchestration controller's queue) that reached a terminal state: completed, failed, cancelled or timed out. Published by the controller (source: the orchestration controller's service id; the status hub's consumer pins it by configuration and refuses any other source) through its durable outbox in the same transaction as the terminal transition, once per run; agent.job.failed is still emitted for failures (finished is the usage record of every outcome). The id derives from the run id, so a re-sent record is a duplicate. data holds names, counts, sizes and times only, NEVER prompt text, task text, tool input or output or model output (the same rule as agent.activity's summary tier): every object is closed (additionalProperties false), so a text field cannot ride along. gateway_tag is the tag every model request of the job carries at the LLM gateway, which joins the gateway's per-turn records to the job (docs/orchestration-telemetry.md). Evolve additively.

profile.description: profile: followed by the run's agent key (as agent.job.failed's agent_key)

profile_revision.description: the agent profile's revision the run was admitted under; null when the controller does not know it

lane.description: shadow: a run whose answer is recorded but never delivered (trying a profile or a route before promoting it)

outcome.description: timeout: a failed run whose failure class is timeout, deadline or budget; cancelled: a cancel (failure class cancelled); failed: every other failure (budget_killed, stall, ...)

failure_class.description: the controller's typed failure class (capacity, stall, timeout, backend-down, handler-error, deadline, cancelled, turn-cap, budget, unknown, ...) when outcome is not completed; null on a completed run

retry_of_run_id.description: the run this one retries (a resubmit or an auto-retry); null for an original submit

auto_retry_scheduled.description: the scheduler auto-retried this run in the same transaction (as agent.job.failed 1.1)

local_attempts.description: attempts made on local backends inside this run

backend.description: the logical name of the backend actually used (the controller's local_backend_used, verbatim: it may start with a dot or a digit); never a URL or host:port (no ':' or '/')

model.description: an opaque model name: the agent runtime's usage file's model, else the passthrough request's model (for a backend served without an alias this can be the model's path); not an alias by contract, no control characters

started_at.description: null when the run never started (cancelled or timed out in the queue)

queue_wait_s.description: started_at - queued_at (null when the run never started)

wall_s.description: finished_at - started_at (null when the run never started)

input_bytes.description: the size of the task input the controller received (task description and request body); the size only, never the text

output_bytes.description: the size of the final answer delivered; null when there was none

usage.description: from the run's usage file; null when the run wrote none

turn_exit_reason.description: why the agent's last turn ended, from the usage file

name.description: the tool's NAME only, never its input

tools.description: tool names and call counts, only when the controller already has them; omitted otherwise

gateway_tag.description: the request tag the gateway records per call for the job's model requests (how a gateway receives it is its adapter's concern, docs/orchestration-telemetry.md): an optional prefix (at most 64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / -, never a comma) followed by the run id
